parsed.why: No trans-specific criminal ban, but zero gender-identity protections, official political calls to exile trans people, judicial gay-panic tolerance, unsolved anti-gay killings and an assault on a gay visitor: hostility with no realistic recourse.

Decriminalisation upheld, 2024 anti-harassment act covers gender identity, highest regional acceptance, Pride held; residual visitor-facing immigration clause naming homosexuals (interpreted narrowly, regionally constrained) and unproven border practice hold it below Low Risk.

State-directed targeting: interior ministry deports foreign nationals suspected of being gay or trans without charges, police entrap trans women via apps, coerced anal exams, media incitement, no anti-discrimination law at all.

Document/entry regime rejects marker mismatches, permits lifetime ineligibility findings, athlete entry ban; facility bans in about 21 states with criminal trespass and one arrest. Offset partially by national hate-crime law, many protective states, working courts.

Anti-discrimination law and hate-crime enhancements expressly cover gender identity (unevenly enforced), no trans-specific state exposure; documented hate speech and attacks on a gender-nonconforming public figure plus restrictive resident LGR keep it moderate.
